findings.evidence: roadmap Suggested.lean:229 `noncomputable def azimuthalAverage (f : VectorTmd Flavor) : TMD.Tmd Flavor`; Average.lean:79 `def azimuthalAverage (f : TransversePlane → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (x kT Q2 ζ : ℝ) : ℝ`; Average.lean:133 `def azimuthalTmd (Φ : ...) : Tmd Flavor`.
findings.fix: Rename `azimuthalTmd` to `azimuthalAverage` per the roadmap, and give the pointwise helper at line 79 a distinct name, e.g. `circleAverageTransverse` or `azimuthalAverageAt`; update the four uses in the file and the module docstring.
findings.issue: The roadmap fixes `azimuthalAverage : VectorTmd Flavor → TMD.Tmd Flavor` as the name of the Layer-2.4 map (roadmap/EpsilonEridaniRoadmaps/WignerDistributions/Suggested.lean:229, and prose at :18 "the reduction into it factors through `azimuthalAverage`"). This PR gives that map the name `azimuthalTmd` (line 133) and spends `azimuthalAverage` (line 79) on a different object, the scalar circle average at a fixed radius. The canonical name is thus occupied with a conflicting signature when the roadmap item lands; `azimuthalTmd` also reads as "azimuthal TMD" (azimuthal dependence/asymmetry) when the object is the azimuthally *averaged*, azimuth-independent TMD.

findings.evidence: In-repo precedent for the same shape: `code/EpsilonEridani/Particles/Parton/PDF/Model.lean:100` `lemma isPartonDensity_modelPdf ... : IsPartonDensity (modelPdf Flavor a b)`. The roadmap also uses the prefix form: Suggested.lean:233 `theorem isTmdDensity_azimuthalAverage`.
findings.fix: Rename to `isTmdDensity_azimuthalTmd` (or `isTmdDensity_azimuthalAverage` after the rename above); update the docstring reference at line 37.
findings.issue: `azimuthalTmd_isTmdDensity` states `IsTmdDensity (azimuthalTmd Φ)`, i.e. object-then-predicate. The naming document's "Predicates as suffixes" rule requires the prefix form (`IsClosed (Icc a b)` → `isClosed_Icc`, not `Icc_isClosed`), and `isTmdDensity` is not one of the listed suffix-style predicates (`_injective`, `_monotone`, …).

findings.evidence: The proof itself rewrites with Mathlib's `norm_circleMap_zero` (Average.lean:67); repo precedent `code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Factorization/Evolution/Reciprocity.lean:312 lemma norm_timelikeAnomalousDim_le`, `code/EpsilonEridani/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:39 lemma norm_spatialPart_eq_sqrt_sq_sub_minkowskiProduct_self`. No other `_norm`-suffixed lemma exists in the repo.
findings.fix: Rename to `norm_radialVector` and `norm_radialVector_of_nonneg`; update the two internal uses (line 72 and the proofs).
findings.issue: `radialVector_norm` (line 66) and `radialVector_norm_of_nonneg` (line 70) name the conclusion `‖radialVector kT θ‖ = |kT|` with the norm as a suffix; read from the conclusion outward it is `norm_radialVector`. Mathlib and this repo use the `norm_` prefix.

summary: Three naming defects: the roadmap-designated name `azimuthalAverage` is attached to a different object than the Layer-2.4 target (which is named `azimuthalTmd` here), the density lemma puts the predicate as a suffix against both the Mathlib rule and the in-repo precedent `isPartonDensity_modelPdf`, and the norm lemmas use a `_norm` suffix where the repo and Mathlib use the `norm_` prefix.
